summary: Page 1 layout matches the January 2019 (ENCS) PDF, but the Part II Items 13-18 ATC schedule is unusable on both API and UI (agent-forms omits bindings for rows 1-6 and refuses runtime keys; the UI Add row dialog omits the ATC picker cell), Page 2 prints an almost blank sheet (missing the official ATC schedule table), and both Item 9 address and Page 2 header name collide with comb ticks.

test_data.profile: Juana Santos long-name demo profile (TIN 000-123-453-00000, RDO 008, Makati long address)
test_data.schedule_overflow_attempted: Attempted to populate ATC rows and overflow past 6 printed rows via frm1601EQ:txtAtcCd8/12 and txtTaxBase9..16 (all 9 refused by form.fill), and inspected UI Add row dialog (missing ATC selector cell).

defects.area: Part II Items 13-18 ATC schedule & Additional ATC rows
defects.description: ATC schedule rows cannot be entered via form.fill (frm1601EQ:txtAtcCd1..6 and txtTaxBase1..6 are unmapped in 1601eq-v2018.json and runtime keys txtAtcCd8/12, txtTaxBase9..16 are refused) nor via the UI Add row dialog (dialog only renders Tax Base, Tax Rate, and Tax Withheld — the ATC picker cell-0 is missing). Items 13-18 stay blank/0.00 and overflow past 6 printed rows cannot be populated.
Long registered address prints as continuous plain text directly over the vertical comb tick marks on both lines.
Prints full name ('SANTOS, JUANA MARIA DELA CRUZ-VILLANUEVA') as plain text over comb ticks instead of Last Name for an individual in comb cells.

defects.area: Page 2 body (Schedule of Alphanumeric Tax Codes)
defects.description: Official January 2019 (ENCS) PDF Page 2 contains the full Schedule of Alphanumeric Tax Codes (ATC) reference table; app prints a 2nd page containing only the header bar and ~90% blank white space.
